key_claims.claim: A random-forest model fusing transcriptomic, proteomic, and metabolomic data predicted ovarian cancer treatment response with AUC 0.939 and identified novel molecular drivers of chemoresistance.
Incorrect AI prompts during mammography reading induced automation bias, causing readers to miss AI-flagged false negatives and over-call AI false positives.
A chest radiograph foundation model predicted 554 prevalent and 457 incident phenotypes across three independent cohorts with explainable imaging-feature co-embeddings.
AI-ECG prediction of incident atrial fibrillation improved physician discrimination from AUROC 0.57 to 0.65 in a multinational simulation of 70 physicians.
A deep-learning model inferring CD8+ T-cell inflammation from H&E slides predicted immunotherapy benefit in clear-cell renal cell carcinoma with AUC approximately 0.78 across two multicenter cohorts.
